primary_interpretation: All three frozen model families show no measurable primary TSS change under the predefined 95% bootstrap-CI rule, without establishing equivalence. At the same time, RF and XGB show TIER_2 explanation-change evidence, whereas LR remains TIER_0 at the global-structure level despite featurewise changes. Thus the dominant cross-model pattern is a majority-model separation between predictive-change detection and explanation-change evidence, not a universal binary stable/drift outcome.
